calibration.adoption_blocker: Revision9 recipe-owned prior comparisons are provisional and require bounded calibration before scientific default adoption. Archived task declarations and gates retain their original identities.

comparison_policy_projection.note: Projected tiers use the older comparison policy only. Actual executed-policy qualification is separate; no projected Tier 3 claim follows from an actual-policy pass.

frozen_catalog_support_closure.scope: Frozen planner catalog evaluator/profile inventory only; captured source and original study support retain their exact bytes. Read-only report overlays cannot introduce previously absent optional source files.

frozen_source_inspection_cache.scope: Original inspect_source, exact immutable frozen root and sorted extra_paths only; original manifest validation precedes cache installation. Requests, receipts, gates and reducers are uncached.

notes: Tier cells show PASS/full declared required task total; diagnostics and ranking tasks are separate.
UNKNOWN means NOT_RUN or missing evidence; FAIL, BLOCKED, INVALID and INCOMPLETE remain distinct.
All required lower-tier gates must pass before higher-tier work is eligible. Unknown later tiers are not failures.
Only the knowledge board's independently graded compatible current receipts fill current cells.
Recipe, prior, initialization, budget, sampling, source and runtime bind each cohort. Clean/noisy serving never pools.
Pinned, calibration diagnostics and historical evidence are unranked and grant no current qualification.

budgets.candidate_and_campaign: required before enqueue; reserve full execution-group cost

immutable_source_inspection_cache.scope: Original inspect_source, exact immutable frozen root and sorted extra_paths only; original manifest validation precedes cache installation. Requests, receipts, gates and reducers are uncached.

registered_study_reconstruction.scope: Resolve only the exact original admitted study ID and Git-pinned motivation; require unchanged study/admission/source/view/full scientific cohort. No training or numerical gate changes.

word_checkpoint_publication.scope: Bind the existing word grader's own-checkpoint proof to its selected smoke parent; numerical grading and original task declarations remain frozen.

executed_policy_qualification.note: Separate actual executed-policy result; this does not change the projected comparison tiers.

blockers: v3 candidate requires an explicit study or registered configuration search before enqueue
